library: KEGG_2021_Human via Enrichr, fixed 2021 snapshot, not current KEGG release
DE: Reuse frozen full tables unchanged; no new DE/grouping
GSEA: all tested genes signed Welch t rank; gene-set permutations1000; weight1; seed20260925; sizes15..500
ORA: up/down P<0.05 and descriptive log2ratio>=0.25 or <=-0.25; full tested gene universe; hypergeometric right tail; sizes15..500
multiplicity: ORA BH all up/down KEGG terms per contrast and joint4; GSEA original empirical FDR; no mixing with prior GO/Reactome q
limitation: Pooled-cell exploratory; inherited donor/subtype/depth imbalance; no metabolic flux or causal inference
